questions.question: Q: A steel rod of 8 mm diameter carries a tensile load of 15 kN. Calculate the stress in the rod.
questions.explanation: Answer: Area = pi x (4)^2 = 50.3 mm2. Stress = 15000 / 50.3 = 298.2 MPa.

questions.question: Q: A 2 m long aluminium bar stretches by 0.5 mm under a tensile load. Calculate the strain.
questions.correctAnswer: Strain = Change in length / Original length = 0.5 / 2000 = 0.00025 (or 0.025%).
